title: Small Footprint
text: Small Footprint. My home coffee station has become cluttered. I was looking to downsize from my full size Keurig machine. I'm so glad I did. This does have the small footprint. Our coffee station has a Ninja coffee maker, an espresso machine, and a coffee burr. Aesthetically, it looks much better. The cluttered look was really annoying my husband! Set up was easy. Directions are clear. The water reservoir is ample enough so I'm not refilling it daily. It's more like every 2 or 3 days. I like that there are different sizes. The coffee it makes is noticeably better than what I was getting from the Keurig. Even my coffee snob husband has enjoyed using the special pod feature. I am very pleased with this!

product_metadata.title: Instant Solo Reusable Coffee Pod with Handle, Compatible with Instant Solo Coffee Maker, 2 ounces
features: Note: 1)Too coarse a grind, too little coffee, or insufficiently tamping the grounds before brewing can all lead to inadequate pressure for a proper brew. 2)It is important to note that the amount of espresso extracted will vary depending on the grind size and amount and reprogramming may be needed when the size and amount are adjusted
Reusable pod with handle lets you brew coffee from your own grounds
Specially designed for Instant Solo Coffee Maker to activate a unique brewing process, extracting more flavor, aroma and body from your coffee grounds
Handle allows easy scooping of grounds
Holds 2 tablespoons (12 grams) of medium-ground coffee
description: This specially designed reusable pod with handle works in the Instant Solo Coffee Maker to brew a delicious cup from your own ground coffee. The handle activates the Instant Solo’s unique brewing process, extracting more flavor, aroma and body from your favorite ground coffee. The handle allows you to easily scoop coffee grounds and is top-rack dishwasher safe.
